sources.name: yt-dlp
sources.author: yt-dlp contributors
findings: POST serialized JSON with text/plain header, additionals empty; all supplied targets together.
Traverses data.threads[*].comments[*] into one flat subtitle list; parent thread/fork not preserved in this output.

sources.name: nndownload
sources.author: AlexAplin and contributors
findings: One worker per target; each request has params.targets=[thread], not one combined request.
additionals res_from=-1000/when and loop are client behavior, not server max/full-history guarantee.
Writes own globalComments object plus retrievedCount; not unmodified API response.
Refreshes threadKey from nvapi comment/keys/thread, handles INVALID_TOKEN/EXPIRED_TOKEN/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS; live authentication untested.

sources.name: nvcomment-gist
sources.author: otya128
findings: Example uses nvcomment.nicovideo.jp with targets/language at root, unlike retained successful requests.
Reports vpos centiseconds to vposMs milliseconds and command string to array; not current runtime verification.
Mentions main/owner/easy and nicoru/source. Key format descriptions not needed for replay; no real key or payload sample retained.

sources.name: niconicojs
sources.author: kongyo2 and contributors
findings: Typed response includes string comment ID, commands array, vposMs and optional fields. Types are code contracts, not live type verification.
fetchCommentsWithKey forwards targets together; returns threads array, dropping globalComments at this wrapper boundary.
Unknown fork normalization defaults to main in this library; not a safe general API rule.
Post-key and posting route appear but are outside R12; no writes performed.
sources.revision_policy: Reused R03/R09 pinned revision; not asserting latest repository HEAD.

prior_comparison.state: Prior yt-dlp/nndownload references were unpinned master. No trustworthy commit-to-commit code delta is claimed.
